page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-24xl is a storage-optimized bare-metal server powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The processor includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) for deep learning workloads. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 60,000 GB of NVMe SSD storage. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer rates. The absence of a dedicated GPU makes it reliant entirely on CPU-based processing, but the high-speed DDR5 memory and direct-attached NVMe storage minimize I/O bottlenecks.

In benchmark evaluations, the i7ie.metal-24xl demonstrates top-tier performance in multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, and database operations, as evidenced by its Passmark database score of 33,739.36 and a static web serving throughput of 133.13 GB/sec. It also exhibits strong capabilities in large-model LLM prompt processing, achieving 39.16 tokens/sec on a 70B model. Given these specifications, the server is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, high-throughput data warehousing, intensive ETL pipelines, and enterprise-grade storage-heavy applications where massive local NVMe capacity and high memory bandwidth are critical.
